bootstrap_policy.note: every bootstrap payload in this artifact records its effective seed; the frontier paired contrasts derive theirs per level and record the derivation

release_wide.definition: bottleneckbench.analysis._failure_stage over every scored row, with completion_no_call substituted for a truncation before the first executed call; its budget and arguments categories are diagnostic and are not the registered budget obligation

definitions.corrected_first_failure_stage: bottleneckbench.analysis._failure_stage, overridden to completion_no_call when the episode truncated before executing any tool call
definitions.scored_population: released episode rows carrying an exact verdict (capacity, repair, sentinel, workflow-frontier, structural holdout); Discovery and ToolSandbox rows use different outcome schemas and are excluded
definitions.truncated: the episode carries model_finish_length, the frozen 1,024-token per-request completion cap
definitions.truncated_before_first_call: model_finish_length with zero executed tool calls
definitions.wrong_conclusion: a scored failure carrying decision_invalid or answer_facts_invalid and no harness-limit error

bootstrap.seed_source: derived per level; each paired contrast records its effective seed

reachability.claim_boundary: an ex-ante feasibility statement about the frozen protocol: no released episode executed the target number of calls, and the cheapest observed cost per call already exceeds the episode token budget at that count, so the level's success rate is a property of the budget rather than of any configuration

quadratic_fit.form: t = a n^2 + b n, ordinary least squares over the rows of this level

interpretation_boundary: descriptive attribution of released failures under the frozen protocol; the conditional non-truncated contrasts condition on a post-treatment variable and are diagnostics, not estimands
protocol_deviation: The hashed protocol protocols/failure-mechanism-decomposition-2026-09-02.md scoped the visible-load decomposition to a frozen 12-configuration subset of the core panel. This release computes it over the full 21-configuration core panel; the eligibility set was widened after the subset's outcomes were known, and the protocol file is retained unmodified. The blocks the protocol names candidate_structural_auxiliary and frontier_structural_auxiliary are released as candidate_structural_additional and frontier_structural_additional, and the panel key the protocol names structural_confirmatory_models is released as structural_registered_models.

exhaustive_accounting.definition: mutually exclusive descriptive terminal flags in declared precedence; categories are neither causal sources nor repair assignments

scientific_role: descriptive decomposition of the released failures; it reports which episodes met which frozen harness limit and does not estimate the effect of changing any limit

confirmatory_only.claim_boundary: the same descriptive resource means restricted to the pre-registered structural holdout; no contrast is re-tested and the class of the block is unchanged

token_telemetry.budget_enforcement: reported tokens drive the episode threshold; zero-token status and response-ID counts below distinguish pre-request availability stops from provider or execution failures. No zero-token row has a recorded provider response. Presence of a usage object does not establish complete provider telemetry, and reasoning/cache breakdowns are not retained in the normalized historical rows
token_telemetry.definition: a released row whose usage object reports both prompt_tokens and completion_tokens as zero; reported-usage coverage counts the presence of the usage object, not its contents

common_resolution_interval.assumption: narrower interval under the additional assumption that truncated failures resolve alike in both arms

manski_bounds.assumption: holds every currently non-truncated trajectory and outcome fixed while allowing each currently truncated failure to resolve to either outcome independently in each arm; it is not an estimate from a larger-cap intervention
manski_bounds.name: truncation-resolution bound

matched_pair_decomposition.definition: a pair is lost when the V=8 twin verifies and the V=128 twin does not, and gained in the reverse case; the split of the lost pairs is by whether the V=128 twin carries model_finish_length

paired_non_truncated.definition: the contrast over the pairs in which neither twin truncated; unlike the marginal non-truncated contrast it keeps the matching, but it still conditions on a post-treatment variable
